comments.agent_turn_limit: Agents have already spoken {turns} times in a row in this thread: {agents} won't be launched until a person writes.
comments.mention_no_prompt: @{agent} can't answer: it has no prompt loaded (neither `prompts/mention.md` nor `prompts/main.md`). Load one in **Agents → {agent}** and mention it again.
comments.access_given: Gave access to {cases} and ran them again.
comments.access_given_secrets: Gave access to {cases} with {secrets} and ran them again.

errors.reason_too_long: the reason can be at most {max} characters
errors.reason_required_send_back: Moving a task back needs a reason: it goes to Comments and to the agent of the stage it lands in.
errors.agent_index_agents_only: only an agent run files its run index
errors.waive_person_only: only a person skips test cases: an agent run cannot record a waiver
errors.agent_needs_repo: Agent {agent:%q} needs a linked repo. Link a project, pick another agent, or mark this agent as works_without_repo.
errors.archive_subtask: A subtask is archived with its parent task: archive the parent.
errors.auditor_feedback_auditor_only: only the auditor's run files auditor feedback
errors.auditor_instance_mismatch: instance must be this auditor's own run
errors.blocked_by_dependencies: The task waits on blocking dependencies. Move every blocker to {stages} first.
errors.boards_disagree: the linked projects default to different boards ({boards}) — pass board_id to choose one
errors.comment_not_on_task: comment_id is not a comment on this task
errors.daemon_owned_fields: these fields are set by the daemon and cannot be patched: {fields}
errors.delete_subtasks_first: This task has subtasks. They share its sandbox and working copy: delete them first, or delete the task together with them.
errors.depends_on_not_sibling: depends_on must reference a sibling subtask of the same parent
errors.hard_dep_after_initial: A blocking dependency can only be added while the task is in {stage}. Move it back first, or add the dependency as a heads-up (kind 'soft').
errors.index_not_positive: index must be a positive integer
errors.limit_not_positive: limit must be a positive integer
errors.instance_not_of_task: instance_id must be a run of this task
errors.message_not_from_person: only a message a person wrote can be moved to the comments
errors.no_linked_projects: task has no linked projects — nothing to push or open a PR for
errors.stage_missing_on_board: stage {stage:%q} does not exist on board {board:%q} — pass a stage to move the task into
errors.stage_skipped_by_type: stage {stage:%q} is skipped by task type {type:%q} — re-type the task or pick another stage
errors.subtask_of_subtask: Cannot create a subtask of a subtask — the hierarchy is one level deep. Add it under the parent task instead.
errors.subtask_order_incomplete: The order must list every subtask of this task exactly once. Missing or repeated: {ids}
errors.subtask_order_not_child: {id} is not a subtask of this task. List only its subtasks.
errors.type_skips_stage: task type {type:%q} skips stage {stage:%q} — pass a stage to move the task into
errors.merge_conflict: the task branch conflicts with the target branch
errors.merge_conflict_files: {count} files conflict with {target}; nothing was merged
errors.merge_no_upload_project: the task has no uploaded project to merge into; a project cloned from a repository gets a pull request instead
errors.merge_pick_project: the task has several uploaded projects; say which one in project_id
errors.merge_required_checks: the merge waits for the checks GitHub requires on the task's pull requests: {checks}
errors.merge_nothing: branch {branch} has no commits to merge yet
errors.section_not_found: the task body has no section {section:%q}
errors.stage_verdict_agent_only: only the stage's own agent files a stage verdict; the auditor uses auditor-feedback
errors.stage_verdict_instance_mismatch: the instance is not the run this key was minted for
errors.flags_import_stage: stage {stage} does not take flags.yaml (ingest_flags is off)
errors.run_moves_own_task: a run does not move the task it works on (stage, type or board): Thulu moves it when the run ends, or a person moves it by hand
errors.flow_flags_person_only: only a person sets flow_flags; an agent sets them through the refinement's flags.yaml
errors.flow_flags_invalid: flow_flags {values} are not valid: short ids like ui or api, at most {max}
errors.access_environment_other_project: environment {environment} does not belong to any of the task's projects
errors.access_environment_required: secrets need an evidence environment: send environment_id
errors.access_no_cases: name at least one test case to give access to
errors.access_person_only: only a signed-in person gives an agent access: neither an agent run nor an API key can
errors.access_unknown_case: the task has no test case {case}
errors.criteria_approve_person_only: only a signed-in person approves acceptance criteria: neither an agent run nor an API key can
errors.stage_skips_patch: stage_skips is not patched: add a skip with POST /tasks/<id>/stage-skips and remove one with POST /tasks/<id>/stage-skips/<stage>/remove

prompts.brief_audit_no_report: The run left no report. Its comments, if any, are in the discussion above.
prompts.brief_board_note: Tasks you create through the `octopus-api` MCP land on this board. Writing to another board is a separate tool, which your agent config may not grant.
prompts.brief_repo_base: - **Base commit:** `{sha}`, where the task branch forks from {branch}. Compare against this commit, not against a branch name: a clone in a pod may not have {branch} (`thulu-gates run --base {sha}`).
prompts.brief_repos_intro: Each repo is mounted at `/workspace/projects/<name>/` once the task leaves its initial stage; before that there is no worktree. In a stage run you edit there and Thulu commits what you leave when the run ends. A mention or an auditor sees them read-only.
prompts.brief_test_cases_intro: These rows are the task's test cases; they supersede any Test Cases checklist in the description. Record results with `task_test_case_run`.
prompts.brief_repo_hosted: - **Repo:** uploaded to Thulu, no GitHub remote. Commit on the task branch and push to origin as usual; there is no pull request: a person lands the branch with Merge into.
prompts.brief_reports_heading:
## Reports of the earlier checks

The latest report of each earlier column whose agent gives a verdict. Each says at its top which commit it looked at; the full history is in the task's Reports tab.
prompts.brief_report_cut: _(cut at {max} characters; the full report is in the task's Reports tab)_
prompts.brief_stage_verdict: **This stage takes a verdict from its agent:** before you exit, write `verdict.md` in the output dir, with the front matter of the `octopus-run` skill (`verdict: continue`, `kick_back` or `block`). A verdict that lives only in your report does not count: a clean exit with no `verdict.md` that reads blocks the task here.
prompts.brief_stage_surface: **This stage writes the spec's surface:** list what the change touches under `surface:` in `flags.yaml` (format in the `octopus-run` skill). Later stages that run only for a surface are skipped when yours leaves it out.
prompts.brief_stage_lock_tests: **This stage locks the tests it writes:** when you exit with code 0, every test file you added or changed must stay as it is in later stages. List other files that must not change either (fixtures, snapshots) in `locked-tests.txt` in the output dir, one repo-relative path per line.
prompts.brief_locked_tests: **Locked tests:** {files}. An earlier stage wrote them as the contract the code must pass. If your run changes one, the task stops here until a person approves the change.
prompts.brief_handoff_heading:
## Handoff

What the other stages passed on to this one, from their `verdict.md` and the auditor's notes. The full reports are in the task's Reports tab.
prompts.brief_handoff_kick_back:
### Sent back from {stage} (`{id}`) by {author}, {when}

This is why the task is in this stage again. Fix what it names first.
prompts.brief_handoff_earlier_heading: ### What the earlier stages passed on
prompts.brief_access_cases: A person gave you what these cases were blocked on. Run only these: {cases}.
prompts.brief_access_secrets: New secrets in the evidence environment {environment}: {secrets}. Refer to them by name; this brief never carries their values.
prompts.brief_skips_remove_hint: If your work makes one of these columns necessary (you touched UI, a migration, auth…), remove its skip with `task_skip_remove` and a reason. A column ahead then runs when the task reaches it; one the task already passed sends the task back there.
prompts.brief_skips_audit: You audit the refinement: check that each skip has a reason that holds for this change. The spec gave risk **{risk}**; a skip on a high-risk change is a finding unless its reason shows the column adds nothing.
prompts.brief_stage_skips: **This stage may skip later columns:** when the change does not need one, list it under `skip:` in `flags.yaml`, each entry with `stage` and `reason` (an entry without a reason is refused and its column runs). Columns you may skip: {skippable}. Never skippable: {never}.

timeline.dependent_removed: {task} no longer depends on this task
timeline.fork_worktree_stale_base: could not fetch the latest default branch from GitHub for project {project}; the fork's branch starts from commit {commit}, which may be behind GitHub: {err}
timeline.kick_back_reset: relaunched out of blocked: send-backs count from zero again
